title: the two pack characters (Chad and Chadaline) first, then the graphics pass on the six
lensAText: a sceptical game art director and character artist. Open the owner's sheets with the Read tool: the six in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/characters/0N-name/ (body-sheet.webp, face-sheet.webp) and the pack pair in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/pack/chad/ (body-sheet.png, face-sheet.png) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/pack/chadaline/ (body-sheet.webp, face-sheet.webp); compare them with the builder's -fx renders and its BEFORE images: is each of the eight now clearly THAT person up close (picker turntable, third person) and at game distance (crowds, for the six): face shape and features, skin tone, hair silhouette (no helmets; Chad's curls, Chadaline's long waves), beards and stubble (soft-edged cards, no box at yaw 45-90 deg, no grey speckle at distance), Marcus's right-eyebrow scar and muscular build, the other builds, shoulders, sleeves, trouser fit, the suit, the dress and shrug, shoes (stilettos with plain black soles), accessories? Are Chad and Chadaline at least as good as the six, attractive, tasteful and original? Is it a clear step up from BEFORE, consistent in style, free of artefacts (gaps, clipping, z-fighting, hard alpha edges, broken hair or cloth)? Did any existing non-cast person get worse? The owner wants the pack pair FIRST: judge them hardest, and check they WORK: the picker's TEST unlock in the test-mode build, each of them on foot in both venues and in the driving seat with their own cuffs. Then take your own frames in ONE short Playwright script on dist/artifact.html: the main menu's Character entry and the picker at 390x844 (phone viewport copy, DPR 3) and 1450x767 (the pack shown locked: 'coming soon, $22.22, 18+'); pick two of the six, walk in Lot 57 and Stoppage Time (via Go To, Get out) and look at the avatar and the crowd up close (the pack pair must NOT be in the crowd); the seat view in the Rossini GT for two characters (their own cuffs and skin tone). ALSO: drive 60 s in the seat view steering to full lock both ways at 390x844 DPR 3 and watch for hand or arm clipping, sleeve popping, z-fighting, flicker, shimmer or stutter; check the builder's alternating frame-time table for plausibility against one short measurement of your own (CDP CPU throttle 4). Stylised real-time 3D is the target, not photoreal: reject for defects and for failing to read as the person, not for being stylised.
brief: THIRD PASS AFTER THE WEEKLY RESET (Fable builder; the owner's model policy: Fable for the people builder's geometry). STATE on disk (uncommitted, on top of 440e96e; read the 'Graphics pass log' and 'What is still short' in PROJECT_OC_CAST.md and the newest PROJECT_OC_PROGRESS.md entry first): stage 1 (Chad and Chadaline working end to end: catalog 'pack', locked picker with TEST unlock, both venues, driver cuffs, not in the crowd, store 2222), stage 2 (beard box and grey speckle), stage 4 (hands-acc.ts options for the six) and stage 5 (perf pairs, base phone group 18/18, all suite groups passing) are DONE by the earlier builders; stage 3 is PARTLY done (Marcus's scar as Look.scar, Garment.leg straight/relaxed trousers, Marcus's greyer beard). THIS PASS finishes the LOOKS, Chad and Chadaline FIRST, then the six: (a) each face's own shape and features from its face sheet, and the dark cheek and jaw shading gone (face.ts, skin.ts, masks.ts, head.ts may be edited, agreed); (b) hair: Chadaline's long waves as real flowing hair (no cap with a curtain, no see-through beside the face), Chad's curls with shape and lighter tips, Leila's waves and Danny's side part without the helmet look; (c) bodies and cloth: shoulders at the right width and slope, no ballooning outer sleeves, collars and lapels, Chad's jacket sleeves as slim as the sheet's, Marcus clearly muscular (extend the builder's range additively if its maximum is too low); (d) shoes that read from the front too, Chadaline's pointed stilettos with plain black soles in particular; (e) Chadaline under the 90,000-triangle LOD 0 budget with margin. THEN: re-run the desktop perf pairs in full (3 alternating base/ours pairs after the fur-sleeve fix), venue frames lit (daytime) with the avatar clearly in view at both venues, full-lock frames that clearly show left and right, the six and the pack pair beside their sheets as -fx3 images, and the suite groups (cast, cast-pack, cast-seat*, cast-pack-seat*, cast-venues, cast-pack-venues, boot, venues, phone). Keep the running log updated. THE FULL ORIGINAL BRIEF for this lane is the file /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/wf/brief-castpack.md (about 27 KB): read ALL of it with the Read tool before anything else; it governs, and it is the brief you build, judge, repair or commit against. In short: one lane for the two pack characters (Chad and Chadaline) AND the six base characters on the improved people builder; HEAD 440e96e already has cast A and the merged face rounds; the owner wants the Chad package FIRST: (1) Chad and Chadaline end to end until they work and operate in the game (faces, hair, bodies, suit, dress, shrug, black-soled stilettos; catalog 'pack'; the picker locked at $22.22 18+ with a labelled TEST unlock in the test-mode build; on foot in both venues; as the driver with their own cuffs; not in the NPC pool; store entry 2222, available false), proven on its own; (2) the shared face work still open; (3) the six's faces, hair, beards, scar, bodies and cloth; (4) the routine parts (hands-acc.ts options for the six, alternating perf pairs, the phone group on a base worktree, renders, suite); a running log at the top of PROJECT_OC_CAST.md so an Opus continuation can take over at the owner's 92 % rule. Everything stays uncommitted until the judges keep it.
